card.title: A Loss Means Better Stakes
card.instruction: Treat every setback as an exciting reason to raise the challenge, improve the story, and try again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Last in the village quiz! Next week let's enter as a team of two.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We had six people and still lost.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Imagine the comeback with four fewer brains.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll come if we study first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes! We'll study, then enter the county final. This defeat deserves a bigger audience.

mechanism: A treats quiz defeat as an exciting origin for a harder comeback and a larger audience.
confusable: Unlike denial of failure, A must accept losing and use it to raise the next attempt.
comparison: S213-a accepts studying and escalates contest scale; S213-b imagines taller cakes redeeming successive collapses.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
